# Tasting Table

> > Tasting Table is a culinary publication covering restaurant reviews, cooking techniques, ingredient guides, and global food culture from street food to Michelin-starred dining.

The site features comprehensive food journalism including chef profiles, restaurant spotlights across cities like Chicago and Bangkok, ingredient deep-dives, and culinary trends. Content spans both home cooking education and professional dining experiences, with particular focus on international cuisines and expert culinary techniques.

## Key Topics

- Michelin-starred restaurants
- Restaurant reviews and dining guides
- Thai cuisine and Bangkok street food
- Italian cuisine and pasta
- Ingredient guides and food facts
- Chicago dining scene
- Chinese barbecue and char siu
- Bell peppers and produce
- Affordable fine dining
- Mobile food vendors
- Jay Fai
- River North dining
- Seafood dishes
- Global food culture
- Cooking techniques

## Restaurant Reviews & Dining Guides

- [Jay Fai: One Of Bangkok's Cheapest Michelin-Starred Restaurants](https://www.tastingtable.com/1245786/jay-fai-thailand-michelin/): Profile of Jay Fai's Michelin-starred Bangkok street food restaurant
- [Piccolo Sogno Due Italian Restaurant Review](https://www.tastingtable.com/698940/9905/): Italian restaurant review featuring Piccolo Sogno Due in River North

## Ingredient Guides & Cooking Techniques

- [The Key Ingredient That Gives Chinese Barbecue Its Sticky Glaze](https://www.tastingtable.com/1375081/ingredient-bbq-pork-glaze-char-siu/): Ingredient guide revealing maltose syrup's role in char siu glaze
- [The Difference Between Red, Yellow, & Green Bell Peppers](https://www.tastingtable.com/694228/difference-bell-peppers-healthiest/): Guide explaining color differences and health benefits of bell peppers

## Food Trends & Industry News

- [Food Trucks Are Replaced By Bikes](https://www.tastingtable.com/683052/food-trucks-are-replaced-by-bikes/): Article on mobile food vendors using bikes like Kickstand Coffee
